data_fields.name: zone_rectangles
data_fields.donor_constant: list of lon/lat rectangles per zone; pick by count, not area

data_fields.name: route_zone_ids
data_fields.donor_constant: ordered zone index per waypoint, with altitude and speed percentage

data_fields.name: wave_spacing
data_fields.donor_constant: spawnTimer in game minutes per wave (unit: minutes, not in the allowed list)

data_fields.name: region_weight
data_fields.donor_constant: ruleset weight, starting value of the region bag

best_idea: Describe a zone as a list of rectangles and a route as an ordered list of zone ids, pick spawn points by choosing a rectangle uniformly by count and then a point inside it, and retry a bounded number of times for a valid spot.
decision_why: Take the zone-as-rectangles data and the route-through-zones shape; do not take the 30-minute geoscape clock, and do not copy the client-triggered kill pause (kills are server-verified). The donor's weighted draw has an off-by-one, so do not copy it.
acceptance: A server test with one zone of two very different rectangles draws each about 50% over 10,000 draws; a roaming group visits zones in listed order; a spawn that fails 100 valid-spot tries is skipped or clamped by one stated rule, never placed on an invalid cell.
